pages.text: Kilele Logistics (SYN), ticker KIL3, is listed on the SYN Securities Exchange in the logistics sector. The ticker of Kilele Logistics (SYN) on the exchange is KIL3. Kilele Logistics (SYN) declared a dividend of SYN Sh 3.44 per share for the year ended 31 December 2025. Net profit of Kilele Logistics (SYN) for 2025 was SYN Sh 4,874 million. The closing price of KIL3 on 2026-09-30 was SYN Sh 49.79.

Kilele Logistics (SYN) has 1,682 million shares in issue. This listing summary is published by the SYN Securities Exchange from company filings and is not a recommendation to buy or sell. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
